verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents wallets, payouts, webhooks and monthly fee transfers, but nothing about settlement or balance reports, per-seller or rolled-up reporting, report file exports, or scheduled report delivery. Wallet infrastructure and event webhooks are building blocks next to this story, not the reconciliation-reporting capability itself.

support.subject: As a developer, reconciliation is automatable — settlement and balance reports per seller and rolled up, delivered as files or APIs my finance stack consumes on schedule
